details: Forwarded to Heren XVII Nov 1663 with request to print; never printed; not found in Dutch or Cape archives (Schapera, Early Cape Hottentots intro). Wreede suggested (not proven) as Witsen's 'diligent observer'; possible transmission to Hiob Ludolf speculated. Identification with Witsen's 1691/1710 Hottentot lists is conjectural, not established.

work: 300-word Pangsoya (Siraya-area) vocabulary given to Warnaert Spoelmans (~1636)
details: No discussion found. Not identifiable with the Utrecht Siraya MS (larger, anonymous). Strong candidate for archival hunt.
Heurnius's Ambonese/Malay work is discussed in mission histories, but no located manuscript of an Uliasser vocabulary found in searches. Likely lost or uncatalogued.

work: Sangirese (Tagulandang)-Spanish dictionary salvaged from Pater Manuel Español's books (Ternate 1678)
details: No literature found; Spanish-era Sangirese lexicography rarely documented. Prime candidate.
Neither it nor Halma's list located in searches.

work: Dutch-Malagasy MS vocabulary sent from Cape 1663 with Jacques Balan report
details: Not found; 17th-c. Dutch Malagasy lists (e.g. Houtman 1603) are known but this one not traced. Possibly related to material later used by Witsen/others; unverified.

Generally treated as lost; the surviving anonymous Utrecht Siraya MS is not securely attributed to Candidius (see Joby's work on the Utrecht MS). Mentions in VOC/missionary letters known via Campbell, Formosa under the Dutch.
Found in Batavia 1839 by van Hoevell; printed in English by Medhurst 1840 and Dutch by van Hoevell 1842 (VBG 18). Original MS whereabouts now unknown.
Three copies sent 1629: British Library Sloane 2746, Bodleian MS Marsh 678, Leiden UB ACAD 224 (Kuiper).

work: 'Mallabaars woordenboek' attached to Stein van Gollenesse memorie (Cochin 1743/44)
details: Memorie itself published (Madras Govt Dutch records series) but the appended wordlist not discussed in sources found; may survive in VOC 1.04.02 copy itself.

work: Elbracht's Dutch translation of a Persian grammar (Bengal 1778)
details: No print found; no literature found.

work: Tamil wordlist (Kramer's teacher, Jaffna ~1716) and anonymous Tamil-Dutch dictionary (de Vries 1713)
Simon Cat Sinhala-Dutch drafts (Colombo 1694) and Portuguese-Tamil vocabulario
details: Kat known as Sinhala Bible/catechism translator; no dictionary MS located in searches. Some Dutch-Sinhala MS dictionaries exist (e.g. Colombo/Leiden collections) but none attributed to Kat found.
Possibly related to Batavian Dutch-Chinese MS dictionaries in Leiden described by Kuiper, but identification unverified.
